paper.title: Variational study of the magnetization plateaus in the spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet: An approach from vision transformer neural quantum states
paper.authors: Andreas Raikos, Sylvain Capponi, Fabien Alet

results.system_description: Heisenberg, 6 × 6 cells · 108 sites · J = 1 · periodic · Sz = 18. H = J sum_<ij> S_i · S_j; spin-1/2 operators S = sigma/2; J = 1; no constant shift
results.source_location: Section on the m = 1/3 plateau (sec:3), text: "e^{1/3}_NQS = -0.34657(2) for L = 6"
results.eligibility_evidence: Zero-field variational energy per site E_0(m)/N of the ViT state optimized within the fixed-magnetization sector (VMC, SPRING), with the Monte Carlo error in parentheses.
results.notes: Heisenberg model Eq. (1) at zero field, spin-1/2, J = 1; kagome rhombic torus of L x L cells (N = 3 L^2) with periodic boundaries; the magnetization is m = 2 Sz / N and Monte Carlo sampling stays within the fixed Sz sector (Secs. II-IV, Appendix on imprinting). ViT with d = 160, n_h = 40, l = 4.
